title: Why we never post AI animals

scenes.headline: Real owl life: getting mobbed
scenes.body: Small birds like this blue jay gang up on owls, calling loudly to drive them away.

scenes.headline: Fake behaviour spreads as fact
scenes.body: Children in our nature clubs learn from what they watch. Invented behaviour teaches wrong biology.

scenes.headline: Our rule: zero AI animals
scenes.body: Real clips only, credited, with a place and a date.

caption:
The real owl story is better than the fake one.

Owls trigger especially intense mobbing because they often hunt sleeping birds; the mob tells the owl it has lost the element of surprise.

Source: Cornell Lab of Ornithology, All About Birds. Real clip: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen); AI clip: Google DeepMind Veo 3 demo (public domain), labelled on screen.
notes: AVOID format: anti-pattern explainer that swaps the invented clip for a real, more interesting behaviour; states our no-AI-animals policy. AI clip is labelled throughout.
